capabilities: chat with AI agents about the open note, with speech transcription and spoken replies
generate text inside notes from questions or instructions
add tags and generate flashcards from note content
suggest note titles and new file locations
update frontmatter properties from template rules
extras: The author is actively looking for collaborators via Discord. Each tool is themed after a historical figure (Socrates, Henry Ford, Agatha Christie, Marco Polo, Richard Feynman, Charles Darwin, Nostradamus).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI features, so tasks like tagging, titling, and flashcard creation must be done manually without model assistance.

relations.evidence: Flashcards are capatible with Obsidian-Spaced-Repitition plugin.
Set-up either OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or OpenRouter using your own keys.

summary: Collection of AI-powered tools that chat about the open note, generate text, add tags and flashcards, and suggest note titles and file locations.
